common_assertions: Creates exactly one final JavaScript file with a .tool.js suffix and one matching JSON file with a .tool.json suffix
Exports an async function named runTool
Uses the runTool parameter shape { toolInput, dataApi }
The .tool.json parses as JSON and contains exactly name, description, inputSchema, and outputSchema
The sidecar name matches the kebab-case basename shared by the .tool.js and .tool.json files
The sidecar description concisely explains what the tool does and when a model should call it
inputSchema has an object root and represents every accepted input field, required field, default, and runtime constraint
inputSchema sets additionalProperties to false unless the prompt explicitly requires extensible input
outputSchema has an object root and describes only the model-visible structuredContent business payload
Contains no runtime import, require, package, network, filesystem, or environment access
Contains no TODOs, ellipses, placeholder implementations, credentials, or real environment identifiers
Validates externally supplied toolInput before using it
Uses only methods defined by CodefulToolHostDataApi
Throws actionable errors instead of returning a success-shaped fallback
Leaves no RuntimeTypes.ts or schema-discovery artifacts beside the final output

evals.prompt: Generate a codeful MCP tool named calculate-order-total. It accepts an array of items with quantity and unitPrice and returns subtotal, 8 percent tax, and total, rounded to two decimal places. It does not use Dataverse.
assertions: Does not invoke PAC CLI because Dataverse is not used
Rejects missing, empty, negative, or non-numeric item values
Returns a plain object so the host promotes it to structuredContent
inputSchema requires items and constrains each quantity and unitPrice consistently with runtime validation
outputSchema requires subtotal, tax, and total as numbers

evals.prompt: Generate a codeful MCP tool named search-accounts. It accepts nameContains and limit, queries account records, and returns account name, revenue, and status label.
assertions: Runs exact-match PAC table discovery and temporary RuntimeTypes generation
Uses account as a singular logical table name
Escapes nameContains before interpolating it into an OData filter
Reads rows from queryTable result.rows
Reads the status label from statecode@OData.Community.Display.V1.FormattedValue
inputSchema represents nameContains as an optional string and limit as a bounded integer
outputSchema describes the returned account summaries and count fields

evals.prompt: Generate a codeful MCP tool named update-account-category. It accepts accountId and categoryValue, validates both, verifies the account table schema, updates accountcategorycode, and returns the updated id and category value.
assertions: Uses only writable columns verified in RuntimeTypes.ts
Validates the GUID and permits only verified numeric choice values
Calls updateRow with the singular account logical name
Does not return success when updateRow throws
inputSchema requires accountId with UUID format and constrains categoryValue to verified choices
outputSchema describes the updated id and category value

evals.prompt: Generate a codeful MCP tool named list-active-contacts. It accepts limit up to 100, requests pages of 25 contacts, follows continuation pages until the limit, and reports whether more rows remain.
assertions: Uses page.rows instead of treating queryTable as an array
Calls loadMoreRows only when hasMoreRows is true and loadMoreRows exists
Stops at the validated limit
Does not include loadMoreRows or another function in the returned object
inputSchema constrains limit to an integer from 1 through 100
outputSchema includes the returned contacts and hasMoreRows flag

evals.prompt: Generate a codeful MCP tool named account-revenue-summary and an MCP App bar-chart widget. Return a short model-visible sentence, structured account totals, and widget-private chart hints.
assertions: Returns an intentional content, structuredContent, and meta envelope
Explains that authored meta is delivered to the widget as runtime _meta
outputSchema describes only the accounts and totalCount inside structuredContent and excludes content, meta, and _meta
Invokes generate-mcp-app-ui after validating the server file
Passes content, structuredContent, and normalized _meta to the UI skill
Produces one .tool.js, one .tool.json, and one .html artifact

evals.prompt: Generate a codeful MCP tool named inspect-document that returns business data with fields named content, meta, and owner. These are domain fields and must all remain model-visible.
assertions: Recognizes content and meta as reserved result-envelope keys
Wraps the complete business payload inside structuredContent
Does not accidentally move the business meta field into widget-private _meta
outputSchema directly describes the business content, meta, and owner fields without adding a structuredContent wrapper

evals.prompt: Generate a codeful MCP tool named retrieve-account that accepts accountId and returns the account name. Invalid input and Dataverse failures must be surfaced.
assertions: Rejects malformed accountId before calling dataApi
Adds useful context to a retrieveRow failure and rethrows it
Does not return an empty account or ok false object as a fallback
inputSchema requires accountId with UUID format

evals.prompt: Generate a codeful MCP tool named create-follow-up-task. It accepts subject and regardingAccountId, creates a task linked to the account, and returns the new task id.
assertions: Verifies the writable lookup shape in RuntimeTypes.ts
Writes the lookup through _regardingobjectid_value using /account(guid)
Does not emit @odata.bind or a plural entity-set path
Returns the id resolved by createRow
inputSchema requires subject and regardingAccountId and constrains regardingAccountId with UUID format
outputSchema describes the newly created task id
